mapper.select: SELECT item_id, seller_id, seller_nickname, title, description, start_price, current_price, status, created_at, updated_at, end_time FROM auction_items WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auction_items ( seller_id, seller_nickname, title, description, start_price, current_price, created_at, end_time ) VALUES ( #{seller_id}, #{seller_nickname}, #{title}, #{description}, #{start_price}, #{current_price}, NOW(), #{end_time} )
mapper.update: UPDATE auction_items SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_price = #{start_price}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE item_id = #{item_id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auction_items WHERE seller_id = #{userId} AND item_id = #{itemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bids (item_id, bidder_id, bidder_nickname, bid_price, bid_time) VALUES (#{item_id}, #{bidder_id}, #{bidder_nickname}, #{bid_price}, NOW())
INSERT INTO consignment (transaction_id, buyer_id, buyer_nickname, buyer_address, progress_status) VALUES (#{transaction_id}, #{buyer_id}, #{buyer_nickname}, #{buyer_address}, 'in_progress')
INSERT INTO auction_image (item_id, image_url, created_at) VALUES (#{item_id}, #{image_url}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE auction_image SET image_url = #{image_url}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE image_id = #{image_id}
